details.eligibility: B.Ed / D.El.Ed — Paper I for Classes 1-5 teachers, Paper II for Classes 6-8 teachers.
details.pattern: Paper I (Classes 1-5): 150 questions, 150 marks. Paper II (Classes 6-8): 150 questions, 150 marks. No negative marking.
details.syllabus: Child Development & Pedagogy, Language I & II, Mathematics, Environmental Studies / subject-specific content and pedagogy.
